ios.desc:
Plate Notes is a food diary without rigid rules.
Log meals, calories, or just quick notes — no fixed meal times, no pressure.

A simple timeline helps you stay mindful of what you eat, even on busy days

Log full meals or just a quick note — whatever fits your day.
Plate Notes adapts to your routine instead of forcing you into strict categories like breakfast, lunch, or dinner

Track calories, macronutrients, and water in a calm, distraction-free interface.
Use widgets to quickly check your daily intake and stay aware without obsessing.

Key Features
– Timeline-based meal diary
– Quick meal notes
– Calorie counter
– Macro & nutrition tracking
– Water tracker
– Barcode scanner
– Statistics & insights
